wide_ae2_terminals.configuration.title: Wide AE2 Terminals
wide_ae2_terminals.configuration.columnC: Number of storage columns. 0 = adapt to the window width. Never less than 9.
wide_ae2_terminals.configuration.maxColu: Upper limit for the adaptive column count (not used when columnCount is set). 0 = unlimited.
wide_ae2_terminals.configuration.sideMar: Space (in GUI pixels) kept free on each side of the terminal (for JEI and the side buttons) when adapting the column count.
